Contact Us

Small Group Office Space Rentals and Team Suites in Calgary's Beltline

Flexible Options

We grow with your business.

Success isn’t always a straight line — that’s why we offer flexible leases designed to adapt as your needs change. Your office space should grow with you.

Perfectly Sized Team Suite

4 Offices for Up to 6 Professionals

Available Exclusively at Mount Royal Executive Centre

Discover our team office suites—a cluster of four adjoining interior offices totaling approximately 500 sq ft.

Each suite includes:

Modern office furniture

Hard-wired fibre optic internet

Access to boardrooms, reception services, and kitchen amenities

Perfect for small to medium-sized teams, these suites offer the ideal blend of privacy and professionalism—a dedicated space for your team with full access to the benefits of our premium business centre.

Benefits Of A Team Suite

Privacy and Conection

Work privately when you need focus, or open your doors to collaborate seamlessly with your team.

Networking

Whether you're joining a social event, chatting over coffee, or grabbing drinks on 17th after work, Mount Royal Executive Centre offers endless opportunities to connect and network with like-minded professionals.

Central Location

Meet with ease in the heart of 17th Ave SW.

Our professional building offers a prime central location with convenient underground parking—making it simple for both you and your clients to connect.

Boardroom Rentals

Host with confidence in our fully equipped boardrooms — complete with professional furnishings, projectors, and whiteboards, perfect for presentations, pitches, and meetings.

Reception

Our on-site receptionist provides professional support—welcoming your clients, managing mail and courier deliveries, and seamlessly forwarding calls to your mobile.
